body:
Reviewed head `3de5c4f23879a58792ea8c9d2771ad022991c532` (7 changed files).

**Code review:** I did not identify a concrete correctness defect in the changed code. The declaration compaction retains token order; the 16-lane full stores have the requested `token_count + 16` output slack (selection's `object_count` is `token_count + 1`); needed-object scans exclude object 0 and keep object-order numbering; lowering includes initializer nodes; and the dotted-asm-label filter is consistent with the generated-name formats. The new scalar/vector guard-page tests and type-count ABI comparison cover the principal new invariants. This is a static review; I did not independently execute those tests.

**Still required before accepting #442 / merging this performance change:**
1. **Authoritative paired 9700X A/B record.** The cited buster-performance#14 record is explicitly from Xeon cloud VMs, not the designated host. Per #442, run the retained harness under the 9700X exclusive lock, pinned to CPU 2, with at least 4 alternating/paired rounds and at least 21 timed passes per TU; retain raw per-run logs, exact SHAs/input hashes/toolchain, per-TU distributions, summed per-TU medians and same-output vs differing-output subsets. Report post-checking PR-vs-main separately from selective-vs-`--lower-all` and whole-compiler effects. An ordinary 9700X correctness CI run does **not** replace this A/B performance record.
2. **Frozen symbols acceptance gate.** The PR reports `--symbols-minimum 348` on a musl 1.2.5 release tarball, expressly not the frozen corpus requested in #442. Run and link the frozen gate (and report any deltas), or explicitly track that unmet acceptance condition before closing #442.

At review time the PR's 9700X CI workflow is still **queued**; do not treat it as passed. No additional code changes requested from static inspection, but this is a **comment, not a performance-gate approval**, until the required host measurements and corpus gate are documented.

Follow-up review of unchanged head `3de5c4f23879a58792ea8c9d2771ad022991c532` (7 files). This updates [my earlier review](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/pull/517#pullrequestreview-5659764724) rather than repeating its static findings.

**Previously outstanding correctness gate: RESOLVED.** The rerun of [9700X CI 40408179517](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/40408179517) completed **successfully**. I checked the actual job log for job `121889389496`: the frozen musl `test-checker-corpus --symbols-minimum 348` reports **351 compared, 0 different, 0 unexplained, 0 failures**; `test-c-testsuite` reports **220/220 passed**; the test step reports **82/82 commands passed**. The first attempt had timed out/cancelled after substantial host-lock wait, but the successful rerun supersedes that result. I withdraw the frozen-corpus reservation from my earlier review.

**Code:** No commits or changes since the earlier review, and the renewed inspection does not reveal a new actionable correctness defect. The AVX-512 masked input loads, compressed output's `count+16` slack, scalar equivalents, stable token/object ordering, and ABI count-only rows remain consistent with their callers and tests. No code change requested.

**Still open for #442 performance acceptance:** buster-performance#14 documents the stage-attribution and paired comparisons **on Xeon cloud VMs**, but not an authoritative **9700X paired PR-vs-baseline A/B run**. This CI job's `benchmark-lowering-source` totals (`referenced_ns=1565313`, `all_ns=1584016`, 21 passes) compare **selective vs lower-all on the same build**, not this PR against the pre-#418 main baseline, and the cross-run CI timing is not a controlled pair. Please run the retained performance harness on the 9700X under the shared lock, pinned to CPU 2, with >=4 interleaved paired rounds and >=21 timed passes per TU; retain raw logs, source/commit hashes, host/toolchain configuration, per-TU medians/distributions, and separate same-output/different-output results, and link that record from #442.

**Disposition: COMMENT / performance acceptance pending.** Correctness CI is green and the prior frozen gate blocker is cleared. No basis for claiming the #442 host performance gate has passed yet. (The PR head's normal 9700X workflow still specifies a 10-minute PR job timeout, including lock wait; that infrastructure risk is separate from this code review.)

Third review — **new head `8a81ea9fd7b7824e6ff5ef35d01646f7abf87889`** (one commit after [my previous review](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/pull/517#pullrequestreview-5660710101)).

**Delta reviewed:** `abi_classify_levels` now caps its traversal at `abi->capacity`; the new calling-convention test grows the type table after initializing a count-sized ABI table and verifies that the count-sized and capacity-sized tables behave differently as intended. In emission, `access`/`defined` are allocated before the declaration list, `defined` is populated during the existing retained-object scan, and the temporary `declaring` buffer is rewound before Tier 0 and linking use scratch. The count/number kernel wrappers are dispatch refactors. I checked the allocation lifetimes and ordering of these passes and found **no concrete regression** in this delta. The full PR's scalar/vector and emitted-object invariants were reviewed previously; I did not independently run the tests.

**CI evidence:** The preceding head `3de5c4f` passed 9700X CI including 220/220 c-testsuite and the frozen musl symbol gate (351 compared, 0 different, 0 unexplained). That proves the former head, **not this new commit**. At this review, the new head's 9700X test [run 40473631037](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/40473631037) is **queued**; measurement-storage CI has passed. Please confirm the new head's tests finish successfully.

**Unresolved #442 acceptance item (unchanged):** The retained [buster-performance#14](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/14) A/B evidence is still Xeon off-host data, not the requested controlled 9700X paired comparison against the pre-#418 baseline. The successful ordinary CI on the previous head does not substitute for that experiment. Keep #442's performance gate open until the locked/pinned, interleaved multi-round 9700X record and per-TU comparisons are published.

**Disposition: COMMENT — no code changes requested from this delta; new-head CI and the 9700X performance acceptance are pending.**

Fourth review of PR #517 — head `29cb281f1d859e4467eac66a7f75e36560b8deb5`, based on `335424b18635fa9ab3ac5eb91e7497aaddd37cab` (after merging main's #151 function-lanes changes). Follow-up to [my third review](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/pull/517#pullrequestreview-5664282201).

**Code:** Rechecked the seven-file PR diff on the new lanes code path. Selection still compacts declarations in token order and numbers needed objects in object order. The lanes emitter now computes its `defined` symbols from the compact declaration list *before* compiling bodies, then frees that temporary list; it regenerates a compact list for the later alignment/attribute passes, frees it before subsequent linking, and retains the separate generated-name detection pass because asm labels are not known in the earlier access pass. Lowering's initializer/declaration scan remains reverse-ordered. Count-sized ABI initialization is paired with capacity-bounded classification. The dotted-asm-label filter still covers names capable of colliding with generated names. I found **no concrete correctness defect** from the integration. This is static inspection plus reading the CI logs; I did not independently execute binaries.

**Current-head CI is green:** [9700X run 40482991684](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/40482991684) completed successfully. I checked job `122117786876` logs: **84/84 commands passed**, **220/220 c-testsuite passed**, `test-checker` **255,122 checks, 0 failures**, the 5,064 guarded declaring/needed-object cases ran, calling-convention worlds **171,786 checks, 0 failed**, and frozen musl symbols **351 compared (minimum 348), 0 different, 0 unexplained, 0 failures**. The old-head CI concern and the frozen-symbol gate concern are resolved for this head.

**Outstanding #442 acceptance:** The PR body says controlled paired 9700X comparisons are being run (historical pre-#418 baseline and current main versus this PR). The linked [buster-performance#14](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/14) remains at the Xeon off-host evidence, with no retained 9700X A/B results yet posted there at review time. Please publish/link the locked, CPU-pinned, interleaved 9700X PR-vs-main record (raw rounds, per-TU medians/distributions, exact commits/inputs, same-output and differing-output subsets) before marking the performance issue accepted. The passing CI `benchmark-lowering-source` is a selective-vs-`--lower-all` comparison on one build, not the required controlled PR-vs-main A/B experiment.

**Disposition: COMMENT — code review clear, latest CI passed; the performance acceptance record remains pending.**
